payload.value: Recall 26639: refund request for Peony Design personalized baby bibs

Hello Peony Design Co.,

I am writing about CPSC recall 26639, "Peony Design Recalls Personalized Baby Bibs and Stroller Bags Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Choking Hazard".
We own Peony Design personalized baby bibs, bought on Etsy in December 2025, and I am requesting the remedy the recall notice promises.

The recall notice says:
"Consumers should take the recalled baby bibs and stroller bags away from children immediately, stop using them, and contact Peony Design to receive a full refund. Consumers will be asked to discard the recalled baby bibs and stroller bags."

Recall notice: https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2026/Peony-Design-Recalls-Personalized-Baby-Bibs-and-Stroller-Bags-Due-to-Risk-of-Serious-Injury-or-Death-from-Choking-Hazard

Please tell me how to receive the refund and what you need from me (photos, proof of purchase, or the items).

Thank you,
Ama Okafor-Lim
